newsitem.title: GERMANY: German BHW Bank ups stake in AHB to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: German BHW Bank ups stake in AHB to 40 pct.

text.p: German savings bank BHW Holding AG said on Monday that it plans to raise its stake in Allgemeine Hypothekenbank (AHB) to 40 percent and to take over management control by April 1 1997.
The company made the announcement about the increased stake at its annual news conference in Frankfurt, probably its last set of results before it goes public in late spring/early summer.
BHW, traditionally a favourite of the country's civil servants, is targeting a stock exchange listing of well over a billion marks in its IPO in April or May.
In January BHW said it had 37 percent of AHB.
